review_description: Found Morphett Air to be genuine people to work with. Weren't the cheapest or most expensive but provided a quality product, sound advice and was very happy with the installation.Service was good and I was supported to get grid connection with my energy retailer. We also found after starting the process that I was in a neighbourhood that had flexible exports with SA Power which added some costs. They took me through the options and even gave me the choice of pulling out of the install but I decided to go ahead. I would recommend this company.
